# Amazon Reviews Scraper

The Apify actor [`junglee/amazon-reviews-scraper`](https://apify.com/junglee/amazon-reviews-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.1.356**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Amazon scraper to extract reviews from Amazon products. Scrape and download detailed reviews without using the Amazon API, including rating score, review description, reactions and images. Download your data as HTML table, JSON, CSV, Excel, XML.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Review $0.006, Date filter $0.0013 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/junglee/amazon-reviews-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/junglee-amazon-reviews-scraper@0.1.356#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      productUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `productAsin` | string \| null | Actual ASIN of the product whose reviews were scraped |
| `productOriginalAsin` | string \| null | ASIN from the input URL before any redirects |
| `variantAsin` | string \| null | ASIN of the product variant for which the review was enqueued |
| `ratingScore` | number \| null | Rating score given in the review (out of 5) |
| `reviewTitle` | string \| null | Review headline title |
| `reviewDescription` | string \| null | Full text of the review |
| `date` | string \| null | Date the review was published |
| `country` | string \| null | Country where the review was written |
| `countryCode` | string \| null | Country code extracted from the reviewed-in field |
| `isVerified` | boolean \| null | Whether this is a verified purchase review |
| `isAmazonVine` | boolean \| null | Whether this review was written through Amazon Vine program |
| `reviewId` | string \| null | Unique identifier of the review |
| `reviewUrl` | string \| null | URL of the individual review page |
| `reviewReaction` | string \| null | Number of helpful votes the review received |
| `variant` | string \| null | Product variant purchased by the reviewer (as a single string) |
| `variantAttributes` | array \| null | Product variant attributes purchased by the reviewer (as key-value pairs) |
| `username` | string \| null | Display name of the reviewer (only present when includeGdprSensitive is enabled) |
| `userId` | string \| null | Amazon user ID of the reviewer |
| `userProfileLink` | string \| null | URL to the reviewer's Amazon profile |
| `avatar` | string \| null | URL of the reviewer's avatar image (only present when includeGdprSensitive is enabled) |
| `reviewImages` | array \| null | URLs of images attached to the review |
| `position` | number \| null | Position of the review on the scraped page |
| `reviewedIn` | string \| null | Country and date information from the reviewed-in field |
| `reviewCategoryUrl` | string \| null | URL from which the review was extracted, including any active filters |
| `totalCategoryRatings` | number \| null | Total number of ratings in the review category/filter |
| `totalCategoryReviews` | number \| null | Total number of reviews in the review category/filter |
| `filterByRating` | string \| null | Star rating filter applied when scraping reviews |
| `filterByKeyword` | string \| null | Keyword filter applied when scraping reviews |
| `product` | object \| null | Product price details (or full product details when reviewsScrapeProductDetails is enabled) |
| `foundNoReviews` | boolean \| null | Indicates no reviews were found for this category (only present when reviewsAlwaysSaveCategoryData is enabled) |
| `input` | string \| null | Input URL that was used to scrape these reviews |
